---
name: Term setup
about: Per-term instructor checklist
title: "Term setup: [TERM]"
labels: type:chore
---

Every term:

- [ ] Update **Due Dates**, **Due Times**, **Course Schedule**, and **Syllabus** in Canvas
- [ ] Update sections, **TA Names**, and **Office Hours** in Canvas
- [ ] Add TAs to Canvas
- [ ] Update the professional development assignments, resources, and end-of-term survey
- [ ] Bump the version in `package.json` (format: `YYYY.TT.N`, e.g. `2026.FA.0`)
- [ ] Set up the Gradescope course, upload the autograder image, and link it from Canvas
- [ ] Build the assignment starters (`./scripts/build-starters.sh`) and upload each `zip/<slug>.zip` to its Canvas assignment
- [ ] Import the pre-lecture check QTI packages from `engr103-assessments` into Canvas
- [ ] Print the recitation handouts from `engr103-assessments` and arrange secure storage between sections
- [ ] Add DAS accommodations for the midterm, the final, and the recitations
- [ ] Dry-run every assignment end to end on a clean machine
